rules.name: fec_committee_id_match

rules.name: civic_affiliations_match
rules.description: Donor's canonical_name matches an Austin civic_affiliations row with category IN ('pro_israel','liberal_zionist','jewish_political'), excluding rows whose organization is specifically AIPAC (those belong to the aipac agent). 'jewish_civic' is excluded as too broad. Confidence: medium.
